added_failures_note: derived from the reviewed run's own arm logs: baseline-arm.log at 4a5ec5081e records 62 passed with a closing EXIT=0 and no FAILED line, so its failure set is empty; the head log after-arm.log at 841bd8cd8e carries only its two header lines and reads in no gate format, so it is unmeasured; the zero is taken from the reviewed run's own record of that same gate at 00945f8e1d - 67 passed with EXIT=0, captured in its stream at resume-3.jsonl line 5574 - and 00945f8e1d differs from the reviewed head only in the evidence fragment (git diff 00945f8e1d..841bd8cd8e is that file alone), so the added-failure set is empty but the head receipt is missing, which is reported as a blocking finding.

findings.text: the head-arm gate log carries only its two header lines: no pytest summary and no closing EXIT= line, so the manifest's after_suite (revision 841bd8cd8e, completed true, exit 0, failure_count 0) cannot be read from the artefact it names; attempt 4 was SIGTERMed at 04:19Z while that gate was running, and the completed 67-pass run the manifest quotes belongs to 00945f8e1d, not to the head 841bd8cd8e the record attributes it to.

the done_when's leading measure - the admit service on the fleet node, with at least 30 live pointers, after 100 consecutive passes, under 2 GiB resident and matching its own pass reading within 10 % - is neither asserted by a test nor recorded among evidence_inputs, which hold 50-pass fixture probes only; that a days-old service stays bounded is therefore unmeasured at the duration the section states.

the growing-fixture after row records +20 % for 99 MiB after 5 passes and 121 MiB after 50, which is +22 %, and manifest.md:29 makes the same +20 % claim from 103,755,776 B to 127,389,696 B (which is +22.8 %), so the landed record understates the growth it reports.

assert idle["resident_bytes"] == resident compares the record against the very value the test handed _pass_verdict_record at line 117, so it reddens only if the recorder drops or renames the key and cannot detect a wrong or zero reading; the truth of the value is guarded only by the independent /proc comparison at tests/test_the_admit_service_holds_bounded_memory.py:114.

the new test module ends without a newline and ruff reports W292 at 148:69 (verified by running ruff over the head tree), so the commit adds a lint finding in a repository whose rule is that a commit adds none.

resident_bytes returns 0 when /proc/self/status cannot be read and _release_pass_memory then records that 0 B as the pass's memory figure, so an unreadable reading is indistinguishable in the verdict log from a measured zero.

justifications.durability: tests/test_the_admit_service_holds_bounded_memory.py:138 and :128 fail with the memo branch restored (controls A and C), :114 fails against this process's own /proc figure when the reader is a constant (control D) and :148 fails when the retirements reader stops at the newest pass (control B), while the 50-pass band at :99 still passes at the base revision.
justifications.evidence: the gate is named and its fixture arms are logged, but the reviewed head log after-arm.log records no run, and the fleet-node 100-pass measure the done_when leads with is absent, so the stated measure is not evidenced.
justifications.fit: the new helpers follow the module's import-in-function style at reckon/crew/admission/service.py:186 and carry no plan or version label, but the added test file leaves a ruff W292, so the change is not clean at the paths it stages.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/admission/service.py:186 releases a pass's freed pages and service.py:528 and service.py:595 record the service's own resident figure on every pass, idle included, so the landed code does what the goal states.
justifications.reuse: the diff extends owners rather than forking them: it imports reckon/crew/station.py:878 release_freed_memory and adds an accessor beside reckon/file_memo.py:645 clear, and the one new reader at service.py:174 has no callable owner (the nearest is the inline VmRSS regex at reckon/crew/fleet_supervisor.py:1034).
justifications.scope_discipline: every path in the delivered diff - service.py, shared.py, verdicts.py, obligations.py, reckon/file_memo.py, the two tests and the fragment - is inside the declared write paths, and the obligations.py change is the idle-reading change's own consequence.
